one_line: Anthropic releases new models and considers an IPO, while Nvidia investigates its CEO over an alleged spy link.

themes.title: Anthropic releases 5.2 models and IPO details
themes.text: Anthropic released the Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 models, featuring faster speeds and improved reasoning and coding capabilities. The company also sent and retracted IPO filing pricing details to bankers.

themes.title: Nvidia investigates CEO and chip probe moves
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he admitted to an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Additionally, a Commerce chip smuggling probe involving Singapore-based Megaspeed was transferred to the DOJ following Nvidia's intervention.

themes.title: New models and infrastructure projects announced
themes.text: Meta launched its lightweight Muse Ember reasoning model, and Google announced two eighth-generation Tensor Processing Unit systems for 2027. Meanwhile, SpaceX proposed a $24 billion gas power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, Texas.

stories.headline: Meta releases Muse Ember lightweight reasoning model

themes.title: EU targets addictive features and AI relationships
themes.text: The European Commission scheduled consideration of the Digital Fairness Act, which would target addictive features and AI systems that simulate relationships.
